opening.argument: The video promotes BitConnect as a lending platform while presenting its returns and continued price growth as legitimate. It discusses the specific one-percent return claim associated with the scheme, even acknowledging the comparison to a Ponzi, yet still predicts that BitConnect’s price will keep growing. The description directly instructs viewers to “Join the team on Bitconnect!”, and the closing remarks tell interested viewers that “the best way to start is to just get started” through linked platforms. These are not merely neutral observations about a disputed investment; they encourage participation while presenting lending-related returns and future appreciation as credible.
